description: This Rust source file defines a collection of helper functions and types for use with the Handlebars templating engine, including registration of helpers, JSON manipulation, markdown rendering, date formatting, static asset path generation, and icon rendering. It also includes test cases for some helpers.
external_files: handlebars::{handlebars_helper, Context, Handlebars, HelperDef, JsonTruthy, PathAndJson, RenderError, RenderErrorReason, Renderable, ScopedJson}

classes.name: StaticPathHelper
classes.description: Helper struct to generate static asset paths based on site prefix.

classes.name: AppConfigHelper
classes.description: Helper struct to access application configuration properties.

classes.name: IconImgHelper
classes.description: Handlebars helper to generate SVG icon images based on icon name and size.

classes.name: MarkdownHelper
classes.description: Helper struct to render markdown content with configurable options.

classes.name: HelperCheckTruthy
classes.description: Helper struct to evaluate truthiness of arguments for conditional helpers.

methods.name: register_all_helpers
methods.description: Registers all custom helpers with a Handlebars instance, configured with application settings.

methods.name: json_eq_case_insensitive
methods.description: Compares two JSON string values case-insensitively.

methods.name: stringify_helper
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to its string representation.

methods.name: parse_json_helper
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JSON value, with error handling.

methods.name: default_helper
methods.description: Returns a default value if the given JSON value is null.

methods.name: starts_with_helper
methods.description: Checks if a string or array starts with another string or array.

methods.name: entries_helper
methods.description: Converts a JSON object or array into an array of key-value pair objects.

methods.name: to_array_helper
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to an array, parsing JSON strings if necessary.

methods.name: buildinfo_helper
methods.description: Returns build information like package name and version based on input string.

methods.name: rfc2822_date_helper
methods.description: Converts ISO date strings or timestamps to RFC 2822 formatted date strings.

methods.name: url_encode_helper
methods.description: Percent-encodes a string for URL safety.

methods.name: csv_escape_helper
methods.description: Escapes a string for CSV output, quoting if necessary.

methods.name: loose_eq_helper
methods.description: Loosely compares two JSON values as strings.

methods.name: register_helper
methods.description: Registers a helper function with the Handlebars registry.
